subject: Demo coordination for Acme Health — timezone constraints and proposed host rotation
messages:

Cc: Sam Brooks <sam.brooks@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Demo availability for Acme Health — timezone constraints

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the intro last week. We’re excited to see Redwood in action. Two quirks on our side: the core evaluation team is US Eastern (NYC) and prefers late mornings (10am–12pm ET), and we also need one of our engineers on the call in California (PST). We understand Redwood’s EU engineering leads will likely host, which could push the meeting to late evening their time.

Can we find a single 60-minute slot next week that keeps things within: 10:00–12:00 ET for our PMs and no later than 21:30 CET for your EU engineers? If not, we’re open to a split session (technical deep-dive with engineers + product overview for leadership).

For context, the evaluation is targeted at: low-latency API behavior across long contexts and multi-region routing (we can share a short list of prompts).

Thanks — Jill

--
Jill Harper
Head of Product, Acme Health
jill.harper@acmehealth.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Demo availability for Acme Health — timezone constraints

Hi Jill — great to meet you (virtually). Appreciate the constraints and the specificity on timing. A couple of quick notes: 

- There is a DST transition in the US on Sun Nov 7 this year; clocks fall back one hour. That will affect local offsets after the 7th but not dates before then. EU shifts are on a slightly different date, so we commonly see a one-week window of awkward offsets.

- Suggested approaches:
  1) Single 60-min session that lands at 10:00 ET / 15:00 GMT / 16:00 CET — that keeps your NYC team inside preferred hours and our EU engineers at ~16:00 CET (early evening) — well before your 21:30 limit.
  2) If your CA engineer needs a later PST time, we can move to 11:00 ET (08:00 PT) which pushes CE(S)T to ~16:00–17:00 depending on daylight rules.
  3) Split session: 30-min product/exec overview hosted by me + 30–45-min engineering deep-dive hosted by Marcus. We’d record the latter.

Marcus is copied to weigh in on whether 16:00 CET is workable for the EU engineering hosts or whether we should rotate to APAC for a follow-on deep dive (Neha can run APAC-friendly follow-ups).

Two concrete times I can offer next week (Nov 8–12):
- Tue Nov 9, 10:00–11:00 ET (15:00–16:00 GMT / 16:00–17:00 CET)
- Thu Nov 11, 11:00–12:00 ET (16:00–17:00 GMT / 17:00–18:00 CET)

If those don’t work, say which day/time window is best and we’ll iterate. I’ll attach a current mutual action plan for alignment.

Regards,
Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan

Option A (preferred): single 60-minute session on Tue Nov 9 10:00 ET / 16:00 CET with the following structure: 10m intros + 20m product walk-through (Tessa) + 25–30m architecture & latency demo (me) + 5m Q&A.

Option B (if Sam’s CA engineer needs better overlap): split into two parts — the exec/product overview at 10:00 ET (no engineer deep-dive) + an engineer-on-call follow-up scheduled at an APAC-friendly time (Neha to host).
